explanation: The page only says it is not known whether f_{k,k}(x) = o(x) for k > 2; it states no conjecture in either direction. The formalization picks the o(x) direction. That is arguably the less plausible one: the standard heuristic, about x/k! k-tuples spread over [0,x], suggests positive density, and Deshouillers–Hennecart–Landreau conjecture that sums of three cubes have positive density. As an open question this is acceptable, but a docstring note on the direction, or the negated form, would be better.
